Bring the new [[Army Recruit]]s to [[Gate Guard Hollis]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| complete = [[The Great Northern Wall]] mission
}}

===Objectives===
* Go from town to Old Ascalon and find the [[Army Recruit]]s.
* Lead all three recruits west along the wall to the far gate and present them to [[Gate Guard Hollis]].
* Speak to Gate Guard Hollis for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Healing Ankh]]
** [[Energy]] +6 (Requires 5 [[Healing Prayers]])
** [[Armor]] +10 (vs. [[Charr]])
** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 10%)

==Walkthrough==
Start from Ascalon City. Outside you will meet three [[Army Recruit]]s, who will follow you automatically. The recruits tend to lag behind the party, and all three must survive to complete the quest, so take care while escorting them. Head to the entrance to [[The Breach]], where [[Gate Guard Hollis]] stands, but do not go through. The quest will be updated when the three recruits have arrived.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Humans]] ([[Ascalon]]ians)
*{{w}} 10 (20) [[Army Recruit]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"There has been more trouble at the Wall. This time, the Charr have assaulted the far gate west of town. Hollis is severely undermanned, so we've been running him reinforcements as they become available. There should be three recruits just outside of the city gates in Old Ascalon, awaiting an escort. They'll get weapons from the fallen when they reach the Wall. In the meantime, I need someone to make sure they reach Gate Guard Hollis safely."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Consider it done!
| decline = I'm sure they'll be fine on their own.
| ask = It should be simple enough to lead the army recruits to Guard Hollis. Just follow the Wall west until you find him. Now enough of this prattling! The Charr might renew their assault at any moment.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Gate Guard Hollis
:''"Welcome to the Wall. Weapons and armor await you on the other side"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Gate Guard Hollis
:''"These recruits look eager. That's something. My thanks to you for bringing them this far with breath still in their bodies. Now we'll just need to scavenge weapons for them from among our dead. Balthazar willing, they'll serve these new soldiers better than their previous wielders."''

==Notes==
* The recruits will stop moving during combat and do not fight back if attacked.
